description: A Layout is a saved grid of two or more terminal sessions shown together (`/layout/<uuid>`). It lives in the drawer's own LAYOUTS section, can be pinned, renamed, reordered, expanded to show its member sessions, saved as a reusable blueprint, and coloured like a hand-made group - a colour, gradient and heading animation picked from the same shared picker, painted on that one row's title text.
examples: Keep a 'release' layout with the api, web and docs sessions side by side and open it in one click.
how_to: Arrange two or more sessions in the terminal grid, then save the arrangement as a layout.
It appears in the drawer's LAYOUTS section: click it to reopen the whole grid.
Pin, rename, reorder, color it or save it as a blueprint from its menu.
media_exempt: a layout needs several live sessions saved together; its picture is covered by saved-layouts and terminal-cells-and-tabs
name: Saved Layouts
summary: Save a named, multi-session terminal arrangement and reopen it as one row in the drawer.
where: The drawer's LAYOUTS section, once you have saved one.
